title: Matching affine covers under field extension
statement: Let k and K be fields with a k-algebra structure on K. For any nonempty scheme X locally of finite type over k, the scalar extension Y is nonempty and there are matching affine open covers U_i of X and V_i of Y with U_i ≅ Spec A_i and V_i ≅ Spec(A_i tensor_k K), where each A_i is a finite type k-algebra. No dimension condition is imposed.

source.place: node lem-pc-dim-base-change, proof paragraphs 2-3; Stacks Tags 01JR, 01JQ, 01T0

proof.text: Choose the affine basis cover of X. Local finite type gives finite type k-algebra structures on its coordinate rings. Inverse images along the first pullback projection cover Y; the open fibre-product and affine fibre-product lemmas identify them with Spec(A_i tensor_k K). Spec K → Spec k is surjective, hence its base change is surjective and Y is nonempty.
